info.title: Gameyfin public API
info.description: Stable integration API. Send a personal token or service key in X-API-Key. Personal tokens mirror the owner's current permissions; service keys require the scopes listed on each operation. Response vocabulary codes are extensible. Lists are not snapshots: periodically reconcile the complete catalog to detect deletions.

put.description: Personal tokens only. Idempotently adds the owner's vote.

GamePatchV1.description: JSON Merge Patch: omitted fields stay unchanged, null clears summary, comment or release; arrays replace their contents. Other null values are rejected.

UserV1.description: Public user profile. Email, account status, SSO status and roles are included only for administrator personal tokens.
